sources.label: CPHEEO / MoHUA water supply manual
sources.note: Common Indian urban planning benchmark: 135 LPCD for cities/towns with piped water supply and sewerage contemplated; 150 LPCD often used for larger cities.

sources.label: IMD climate normals and city climate reports
sources.note: Used for normal/average annual rainfall where available. Values should be verified for project design against latest local IMD station data.

sources.label: Municipal / district / CGWB public documents
sources.note: Used for indicative municipal/city area. Administrative boundary definitions vary; project tools must confirm the exact site boundary.

gurugram.name: Gurugram
gurugram.sourceNote: Rainfall: Gurugram SFD Lite / Census DCHB reference; area: Municipal Corporation Gurugram boundary commonly cited around 232 sq km; demand: CPHEEO 135 LPCD benchmark.

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.sourceNote: Rainfall: IMD Jaipur climate report; area: CGWB Jaipur city/agglomeration references around 467.57 sq km; demand: CPHEEO larger-city benchmark.

delhi.name: Delhi
delhi.sourceNote: Rainfall: IMD Safdarjung climate normal; area: NCT Delhi administrative area; demand: CPHEEO larger-city benchmark.

mumbai.name: Mumbai
mumbai.sourceNote: Rainfall: BMC/IMD annual average references; area: Greater Mumbai municipal area; demand: CPHEEO larger-city benchmark.

bengaluru.name: Bengaluru
bengaluru.sourceNote: Indicative city baseline for tool prototyping; verify rainfall, BBMP area and population before project use.

pune.name: Pune
pune.sourceNote: Indicative city baseline for tool prototyping; verify rainfall, municipal area and population before project use.
